description: This source file defines the ControlChannel class and related data structures for managing and interacting with a control communication channel, including connection management, event handling, error handling, and heartbeat monitoring. It serves as a core part of the application's control communication subsystem.

classes.name: ControlChannel
classes.description: A singleton class managing the control communication channel, including connection states, event stream handling, error management, and recovery logic.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the control channel in local or remote mode, establishing connection endpoints as needed.

methods.name: refreshEndpoint
methods.description: Refreshes the connection endpoint, attempting to establish a gateway connection and updating the connection state.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Shuts down the gateway connection and resets connection status.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Performs a health check on the control channel, returning diagnostic data.

methods.name: lastHeartbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the last heartbeat event received from the control channel.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Sends a request over the control channel with specified method and parameters, returning the response data.

methods.name: sendSystemEvent
methods.description: Sends a system event message with given text and parameters.
